_comment: Milestone E — trust-roots TEMPLATE for the canonical aws-cli scenario.
Public key material only (private keys are NEVER git-tracked, AC-26).
This is a TEMPLATE: the e2e fixture builder generates real Ed25519 keys at
run time and substitutes their fingerprints + SPKI public keys into the
`fingerprint`/`publicKey` fields below, then hashes the concrete file into
the signed config-manifest (AC-46). The shapes here match the TrustRoot
record (AC-6): every root carries its own key material and a declared kind.
Roles referenced by the policy (`role:sre-oncall`) resolve to the fingerprints
of the human roots whose identityId is the on-call identity.
